product_mapping.note: ProductsID is not the join key. Each ProductsID maps to one product name; a product name may map to multiple ProductsID values.

field_sources.brand: price-promo.Brand (cleaned POS has no brand column)
field_sources.date: join key: POS.date / price-promo.DDMMMYY parsed with %d %b %y
field_sources.pos_current_price: POS.current_price (realised / average selling price from the POS extract)
field_sources.off_promo_price: price-promo '4 Weeks CY Ave Price Quantity' where Promotion Indicator = 0
field_sources.on_promo_price: price-promo '4 Weeks CY Ave Price Quantity' where Promotion Indicator = 1
field_sources.off_promo_rsp: price-promo '4 Weeks CY Ave RSP On Promo' where Promotion Indicator = 0 (not proven as normal shelf price)
field_sources.on_promo_rsp: price-promo '4 Weeks CY Ave RSP On Promo' where Promotion Indicator = 1 (not proven as normal shelf price)
field_sources.off_promo_sales: price-promo '4 Weeks CY Sales On Promo' where Promotion Indicator = 0
field_sources.on_promo_sales: price-promo '4 Weeks CY Sales On Promo' where Promotion Indicator = 1
field_sources.off_promo_time: price-promo 'CY % Time On Promo' where Promotion Indicator = 0
field_sources.on_promo_time: price-promo 'CY % Time On Promo' where Promotion Indicator = 1
field_sources.off_promo_sales_pct: price-promo '4 Weeks CY % Sales On Promo' where Promotion Indicator = 0
field_sources.on_promo_sales_pct: price-promo '4 Weeks CY % Sales On Promo' where Promotion Indicator = 1
field_sources.promotion_indicator_off_present: true if a Promotion Indicator = 0 source row existed for the grain
field_sources.promotion_indicator_on_present: true if a Promotion Indicator = 1 source row existed for the grain
field_sources.promotion_states: sorted Promotion Indicator values observed at the grain (e.g. '0|1')
field_sources.productsid: pipe-separated distinct price-promo.ProductsID values at the grain (lineage only, not a join key)
field_sources.productsid_count: number of distinct ProductsID values at the grain
field_sources.price_promo_source_rows: raw price/promo rows collapsed into the grain
field_sources.in_pos: true if a cleaned POS row exists for the grain
field_sources.in_price_promo: true if a pivoted price/promo grain exists
field_sources.price_promo_available: true if this grain matched the price/promotion source (row-level)
field_sources.flag_unmatched_pos: POS grain with no price/promo grain
field_sources.flag_unmatched_price_promo: price/promo grain with no POS grain
field_sources.flag_multiple_source_matches: more than one price/promo row per Promotion Indicator (typically multiple ProductsID)
field_sources.flag_missing_price: pos_current_price, off_promo_price, and on_promo_price are all missing
field_sources.flag_missing_promotion_metrics: all six pivoted off/on promo metric columns are missing
field_sources.flag_missing_rsp: off_promo_rsp and on_promo_rsp are both missing
field_sources.flag_price_promo_unavailable_for_period: the row date does not exist in the price/promotion source calendar
field_sources.flag_ambiguous_product_mapping: the product name maps to more than one ProductsID at this grain

limitations: Join key is Product + Retailer + Region + Date. ProductsID is lineage only.
Promotion Indicator 0/1 is pivoted into off_promo_* / on_promo_* columns; two source rows per grain are a promotion state, not a duplicate.
4 Weeks CY Ave RSP On Promo is stored as off_promo_rsp / on_promo_rsp and is not renamed to normal price.
Missing price and promotion metrics are preserved as missing; they are not converted to zero.
POS weeks with no price/promotion source remain in the canonical table: 2026-07-26
Price/promotion calendar has 3 overlapping week(s); not a 12-week price/promo panel.
56888 POS records have no price/promotion grain (not forced to match).
63665 price/promotion grains have no POS row (broader Unilever house and extra banners).
57 product names map to multiple ProductsID values.
764 POS product names are absent from the price/promo extract.
705 canonical grains collapsed multiple ProductsID rows per indicator; conflicting metrics are left missing.
Price Agent, Promotion Agent, and Commercial Brain are not built in this sprint.
